scope: Explicit source-only package selections; no dependency install, build, semantic validation or runtime tests. Not whole-repository scorecards or cross-ecosystem calibration.

policy.aggregation: 40% one worst + 60% mean remaining; one half-up rounding to one decimal
policy.purpose: Statement-based sensitivity preview; thresholds and weights are not yet accepted production policy.
policy.limits: Size does not establish responsibility. CC and MI overlap must be reviewed before adding any deduction.

verification.scoreBaselines: compatible; no new/resolved findings or warning/score-drop gates
